example: 8 markers in 2 equal groups means 4 in each group.

def: To add the same number many times to find a total.
A number that shows part of a whole.
example: 1/2 is one piece of a whole cut into 2 equal parts.

def: One complete thing before it is cut into parts.
example: One full cup of rice is 1 whole.
